title: Send Pacing Scheduler
dek: tempoledger, a scheduler I built for simulated phishing texts in security-awareness training, paces each message the way a person would send it: never sooner than it could have been typed. This page rebuilds it in your browser and runs its own audit, which catches the schedule breaking that rule.
summary: In all 1,000 runs of its own example, the scheduler sends its last two messages before a person could have typed them.
